svg.title: SigLIP2 b16 classify
svg.desc: Image input 256 × 256; text length 64. Classify example: 3 classes, one prompt each. Fixed-resolution SigLIP graph.
svg.text: Image input 256 × 256; text length 64. Classify example: 3 classes, one prompt each. Fixed-resolution SigLIP graph.

g.text: No CLS token. Convolution uses valid padding.
Postprocess: softmax by default; optional multi_label=True applies sigmoid.
S: image size. P: patch size. N: image tokens. E/D: tower/output width. n: repeats in each tower. h: heads. M: MLP width.
